conn.nameHint: name — referenced by roads and placementArgs
conn.connectionTypeHint: connectionType — Direct: a straight corridor; Default: the generator picks the shape; Portal: a portal (pair of gates); Proximity: zones are simply adjacent (length sets the distance); GladiatorArena: arena entrance
conn.guardValueHint: guardValue — −10000…5,000,000; negative values (−10000…−2000) occur on secondary passages — semantics unknown, experimental
conn.guardWeeklyHint: guardWeeklyIncrement — 0.05–0.25; the fraction by which the guard grows each week
conn.guardZoneHint: guardZone — which zone the guard is taken from (by default — in the middle)
conn.guardGroupHint: guardMatchGroup — a named group of symmetric guards (guardValue/guardWeeklyIncrement/guardRandomization must match within the group)
conn.guardEscapeHint: guardEscape — hypothesis: allow the guard to leave (guard bypass)? Always false in stock templates; behavior when true is unknown
conn.roadHint: road — whether there is a road along the connection
conn.simTurnSquadHint: simTurnSquad — hypothesis: the guard counts in simultaneous turns. Always true in stock templates (48 files)
conn.gatePlacementHint: gatePlacement — Center: shared gates in the center (stock); NearZone: gates in the specified zone
conn.gatePlacementArgsHint: gatePlacementArgs — zone where the gates are placed (with NearZone)
